senses.gloss: (= מא הי) what?; why? Ber. 2ᵃ מ׳ שנא דתני וכ׳ what does the change in putting evening before morning mean?, i.e. why does the redactor of the Mishnah put &c.? Ib. וּמִמַּאי דהאי וכ׳ and whence is it proven that this &c.?—
units: Ib.ᵇ ומ׳ וטהר and what does v’taher mean? Ib. מ׳ ואומר why this v’omer, i.e. why is another citation required? Ib. 3ᵇ, a. fr. מ׳ לאו, v. לַאו.
<cite ref="Berakhot 3b:31">Ib.</cite>, a. fr. <he>מ׳ טעמא</he>, v. <cite ref="I00612"><he>טַעֲמָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Chullin 107b:16">Ḥull. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>וכי נוגע … מ׳ הוי</he> and even if one touch the other, what of it? <cite ref="Chullin 107b:13">Ib.</cite> <he>אמ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A01967"><he>אַמַּאי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Gittin 56b:7">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>אסוותא … מ׳ היא</he> those remedies (mentioned before) which cured R. Z.,—what are they? <cite ref="Pesachim 3b:14">Pes. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ האי דקמן</he> what does this (case) before us mean? <cite ref="Sanhedrin 39a:16">Snh. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ האי</he> what does this (sigh) mean?—

<cite ref="Pesachim 9a:6">Pes. 9ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>האי מ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="E00010"><he>הַאי</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—In Talm. Y. also <cite ref="M01074"><he>מַי</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01136"><he>מַיי</he></cite>. Y. Ber. VI, 10ᵇ; ib. III, 6ᵇ bot., v. <cite ref="K00116"><he>כְּדוּן</he></cite>; a. fr.
